preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
Number of strings in each test case is between 1 and 100,000.
Each string has a length between 1 and 8.

preconditions.expression: for each string s_i, s_i consists of lowercase English letters
preconditions.description: Each string consists of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: for each test case, output is a binary string of length n
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a binary string of length equal to the number of strings in that test case.

postconditions.expression: for each i, output[i] == '1' if there exist j, k such that s_i = s_j + s_k, else output[i] == '0'
postconditions.description: The i-th bit in the output is '1' if there exist two strings s_j and s_k such that s_i is the concatenation of s_j and s_k, otherwise it is '0'.
